diagnosis: CorporatePolicyDocument is bound to specific Django sites via a ManyToManyField 'sites' representing regional legal entities (e.g. EU vs US vs Classified Aerospace). CorporatePolicyDetailView fetches the document by slug without filtering by the host site (sites=get_current_site(request)). Any authenticated employee on an unclassified public subsidiary intranet can access restricted policies of other corporate divisions.
